services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe & Leak Repairs
services.desc: Water damage won't wait. We attend burst pipes and leaks same day, often within the hour. We'll stop the damage and get your water back on.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Faulty boiler? We diagnose and repair most faults on the first visit, with parts carried on the van. Annual servicing keeps your system safe and efficient.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with full warranties and guarantees. We'll advise on the right size and model for your home, then install it to Gas Safe standards.

services.title: Central Heating System Design & Install
services.desc: New radiators, pipework, and controls fitted to keep every room warm. We design systems tailored to your home's layout and your budget.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap repairs, sink replacements, and new bathroom suites installed with care. We handle the plumbing and make sure everything works and looks great.

services.title: Power Flushing & System Maintenance
services.desc: Keep your heating system running smoothly with power flushing to remove debris. Regular maintenance cuts bills and prevents breakdowns.

about_pullquote: We started this because we were fed up seeing dodgy work and rip-off pricing in Sunderland.
about_para_1: JC Plumbing & Heating has served Sunderland homes and businesses for 18 years. We began as a one-man operation fixing his neighbours' heating problems, and we've grown into a team of Gas Safe registered engineers who take pride in getting it right first time. Every job is done to the highest standard—no cowboys, no shortcuts.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, give straight advice, and don't pad invoices. We've completed over 2,000 jobs across Sunderland and the surrounding areas, from student flats to period homes to commercial premises. We're local, we're honest, and we're always ready to help when things go wrong.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at half two in the morning just before Christmas. Called JC Plumbing thinking I'd have to wait days. They were here by three and had it sorted and cleaned up by four. Absolute lifesavers. Fair price too, no surprise charges. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler died on the coldest day of the year. JC came out same morning, diagnosed a faulty heat exchanger, and fitted a new boiler the next day. The whole process was smooth and the engineer explained everything clearly. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Been using JC for three years now. Annual servicing keeps the heating running perfectly. Staff are friendly, punctual, and they never try to upsell you stuff you don't need. That's rare these days. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.
